body:
The original M1 uses 207,928 reachable binary arcs. This adds an exact node-activity representation with continuous movement flows, preserving all accepted scientific routes and every original physical row. Binary dimension falls from 208,312 to 9,422 (95.476977%), while total columns, rows, and nnz increase; this is an integer-dimension reduction.

Base: Draft PR #120 exact head `126861e39fd1cb00bbea60d3b2d61239f1de5185`, sibling branch. The stopped Benders acceleration branch is neither resumed nor imported.

| Construction | Original | Compact |
|---|---:|---:|
| Binary | 208,312 | 9,422 = 9,038 node + 384 mode |
| Continuous | 108,431 | 307,417 |
| Columns | 316,743 | 316,839 |
| Rows | 954,560 | 972,540 |
| Nonzeros | 8,282,350 | 12,678,118 |
| Parallel selectors | n/a | 0 |

Exactness PASS: formal DAG/unit-flow integrality proof, bidirectional mappings, exhaustive 12 fixtures/31 route-ID path comparisons and 19 infeasible fractionality probes, two additional physically feasible multi-move sequences, native connect/depart/SOC authority audit, exact rational coefficient audit of 187,786 changed rows, and independently validated inherited UB mapping.

Fresh same-F3 root LPs are OPTIMAL with identical primal-presolve barrier settings: Original `0.5718494620559795` (56.68s), Compact `0.5718494622717606` (74.85s), difference `2.16e-10`. Both primal mappings PASS. Earlier simplex time limits, crossover interruption, and SUBOPTIMAL/interrupted automatic-dual attempts remain visible. PreDual=0/Crossover=0 was separately registered for LP certification; the frozen MILP Method=1 policy did not change. Historical stronger S2 LB is retained externally and not confused with unstrengthened F3.

Sequential C0 then C1, 600s each, Threads=4, Seed=20260929, MIPGap=0.005, Heuristics=0: both TIME_LIMIT, no solver incumbent, raw BestBd `0.28222432055490354`, one root node each, incomplete root relaxation. Presolve keeps 208,312 vs 9,326 binaries. Both starts were rejected. Read-only audit finds the same two equalities exceeding the registered 1e-8 feasibility tolerance (max 3.0752360699604075e-8), although the inherited physical validator passes. This is a plausible rejection cause, not a solver-reported diagnosis.

Retained original-M1 UB/LB are `0.5912812634331275` / `0.5722125039436496`, gap 3.22498964%, on both arms. No material valid bound/gap gain or post-root performance gain is demonstrated. Verdict: `STOP_CANARY_START_NOT_ACCEPTED`. This does not establish compact performance inferiority.

The frozen worker saved both raw 600s receipts, then encountered a missing-incumbent postprocessing KeyError. Its exit=1/traceback is preserved. Read-only certificate finalization handles missing fields conservatively; a new regression test covers this case. No optimizer re-run, Start repair, or post-result policy change occurred.

`COMPACT_M1_PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED=false`, P1/M1 acceptance false, production 1800s MILP NOT_RUN. P2/A2/M2/Actual/Fresh AC NOT_RUN, Actual P/Q repair OFF, Problem13 FINAL false. New scientific experiment Benders master/recourse/Farkas/Phase-I counts are all zero; inherited bounded toy Benders regression tests are disclosed separately.

Resource receipts record hardware, CPU, 16 available logical cores, RAM/pagefile, process command lines, and observed concurrent workers. Independent work was allowed; own heavy lane was sequential, Gurobi=4 and process BLAS/OpenMP limits=1. No historical absolute speedup claim.

Validation: `python -m pytest -q` — **878 passed**, no skips, one inherited calibration log1p RuntimeWarning, 97.24s. `git diff --check` passes. All 2,365 inherited tracked physical files are preserved, and source/cache/preregistered policy hashes verify. Evidence, raw logs, 80-Q&A Korean review, next modifications, final flags, and SHA manifest are under `docs/v42_m1_compact_monolithic/`. Large exact sparse model/start/solution caches remain local and are identified by sealed SHA receipts.
title: V42 M1 exact node-activity MILP: root certified, canary Start gate unmet
